title: The Hunting Party
author: Lucy Foley
summary: A group of old university friends gathers at a remote Scottish lodge to see in the New Year. A blizzard cuts them off, and by morning one of them is dead and the rest are suspects.
readIf: you like a snowed-in whodunit with a group of friends whose past is turning ugly.
skipIf: you dislike unlikeable characters, because almost everyone here is a bit awful.

pairings.reason: The author's other country-house thriller, with another storm and another party gone wrong.
The classic that started the isolated-group-and-killer structure, still the sharpest of them all.
A shorter story of a remote house, a group of old friends and an unfolding crime.
